channel.title: Daily Recap — 🏰 Disney News
channel.description: What happened in 🏰 Disney News, recapped daily from subscribed feeds.

item.title: Holidays at Disneyland kick off today, running through January 6
item.description:
The holiday season officially arrives at Disneyland Resort today, November 13, and runs through January 6, 2027. The parks are decked out in lights and ornaments, with seasonal entertainment and festive food and merchandise across both parks and the resort hotels.

Characters are dressed in their holiday finest throughout the season, making it a prime window for festive photos and character encounters. If you're planning a visit, the holiday programming is now in full swing — the guides lay out what's on, where to find it, and which characters to look for.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Guide to Holidays at the Disneyland Resort 2026
  • Disney Parks Blog: 2026 Holiday Characters to Spot at Disneyland

item.title: Where to meet Santa at Disney World this holiday season
item.description:
Santa Claus is making the rounds at Walt Disney World this holiday season, with meet-and-greet stops across all four theme parks and Disney Springs. The resort is leaning into the festive atmosphere with thousands of lights and holiday music to match.

If a Santa photo is on your family's must-do list, check the guide for which parks he's visiting and where to find him — appearances are spread across the resort rather than confined to a single spot, so a little planning goes a long way.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Where to Meet Santa at Disney World This Holiday Season

item.title: Life Day merchandise arrives for Star Wars fans on November 17
item.description:
Star Wars Life Day falls next Tuesday, November 17, and Disney is marking the Wookiee holiday — a celebration of family, harmony, and joy first introduced in the 1978 Star Wars Holiday Special — with a new line of merchandise at the Disney Store and in the parks.

Expect the red Life Day robes, festive decor, and lights that have become the holiday's signature. It's a niche but beloved corner of Star Wars fandom, and the merch drop gives collectors and Galaxy's Edge visitors something new to hunt for ahead of the day itself.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Star Wars Life Day Merchandise Coming to Disney Store and Disney Parks

item.title: Droid Depot: build and customize your own droid at Galaxy's Edge
item.description:
Droid Depot in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge remains one of the parks' signature hands-on experiences, letting guests build and customize their own astromech or protocol droid from a parts wall spanning the saga's droid designs — from battered protocol units to the unlikely heroes of Kashyyyk and Naboo.

It's both a souvenir and an activity: you pick the parts, assemble the droid, and take home a one-of-a-kind companion. For anyone visiting Galaxy's Edge at Disneyland or Disney World, it's worth knowing the experience exists before you arrive, since builds are popular and slots can fill up.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Build, Customize, and Collect: Droid Depot at Disneyland and Disney World

item.title: How much of Magic Kingdom is actually behind construction walls
item.description:
A crane towers over Magic Kingdom and construction walls stretch from Liberty Square to Frontierland as Disney builds Piston Peak National Park and Villains Land — two of the biggest expansions in the park's history. A new look at the work as of late 2026 maps out just how much of the park is affected and what guests will actually notice.

The short version: the construction footprint is real and visible, but much of the park remains open and operating normally. If you're visiting soon, it's worth knowing which areas are walled off so you can plan around them — and what the reimagined lands will eventually bring.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Here's How Much of Magic Kingdom Is Actually Impacted by Construction

item.title: Bryan Cranston leaks Carousel of Progress reopening: May 2027
item.description:
While making a surprise appearance at EPCOT for a tequila tasting event, actor Bryan Cranston leaked that the reimagined Carousel of Progress will reopen at Magic Kingdom in May 2027. Cranston is one of the celebrities lending their voice to the updated attraction, which is being reworked with new scenes and talent.

The leak gives fans the first firm timeline for the return of one of Walt Disney World's most storied attractions. The reimagining has been closely watched because Carousel of Progress is a piece of Disney history — a Walt-era show — and how Disney updates it without losing its charm is the question every fan is asking.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Bryan Cranston Leaks When Reimagined Carousel of Progress Will Open at Magic Kingdom

item.title: Star Wars turns 50 in 2027, with reimagined park offerings and new merch
item.description:
Star Wars will celebrate its 50th anniversary in 2027, and Disney is planning "reimagined" offerings at Walt Disney World, Disneyland, and Disney Cruise Line. In a preview shared 50 days before the milestone year begins, Lucasfilm and Disney laid out what fans can expect across the parks and the cruise line.

The celebration also brings a new wave of anniversary merchandise, with Disney previewing products tied to the 50-year milestone. Star Wars debuted in 1977 and has grown into a global cultural phenomenon, and Disney is clearly treating the 50th as a parks-wide event rather than a single celebration.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Parks "Reimaginings" for Star Wars 50th Anniversary in 2027
  • Disney Parks Blog: The Force Connects Us: Celebrating 50 Years of Star Wars with New Products

item.title: EPCOT Festival of the Holidays: full menus, 98 new items, and a Figment popcorn bucket
item.description:
Walt Disney World has released full menus and food photos for the 2026 EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays, running November 27 through December 30, 2026. The lineup covers 98 new dishes, desserts, and drinks across 20 Holiday Kitchens, plus returning items — and the first-ever Figment popcorn bucket, with the dragon sporting a not-so-ugly Christmas sweater.

The festival celebrates holiday traditions from around the world with festive flavors and entertainment throughout EPCOT. With nearly 100 new items, this year's food lineup is being billed as arguably the best ever, and the Figment bucket is likely to be the collectible everyone queues for.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Full Food Menus for 2026 EPCOT Festival of the Holidays: Figment Christmas Popcorn Bucket and 98 New Items!
  • Disney Parks Blog: Disney Eats: Foodie Guide to EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays 2026

item.title: 2027 Moonlight Magic dates revealed for Disney World — nothing for Disneyland
item.description:
Disney Vacation Club is bringing back the free Moonlight Magic after-hours parties to Walt Disney World in 2027, with dates at EPCOT, Animal Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, and Typhoon Lagoon. During these parties, DVC members can experience the parks after hours with shorter lines and special entertainment.

The catch: there are no nights at the castle parks on either coast, and nothing at Disneyland Resort at all. For DVC members, the 2027 calendar is good news for Florida trips — but Disneyland members are left out entirely this year.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: 2027 Moonlight Magic Party Dates & Registration Revealed for Disney World, Nothing for Disneyland

item.title: Disneyland unwraps its holiday entertainment: parades, fireworks, and ride overlays
item.description:
Disneyland is rolling out its full holiday entertainment lineup: Christmas songs along the Main Street, U.S.A. parade route, fireworks lighting up the night sky above Sleeping Beauty's Winter Castle, beloved holiday ride overlays, and a lineup of new seasonal menu items.

The holidays at Disneyland lean heavily on atmosphere — the castle, the parade, and the music — and this year's program pairs the returning favorites with fresh food offerings. For anyone planning a December visit, the parade and fireworks are the centerpieces, with the overlays and menus rounding out the seasonal offering.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Disneyland Holiday Entertainment: Christmas Parade, Fireworks, and More

item.title: Disney celebrates 100 years of the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
item.description:
The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has long marked the official start of the holiday season for many Americans, and in 2026 the storied spectacle turns 100. Disney is joining the centennial celebration, with festivities tied to the milestone across its experiences.

The parade has been seen by generations of viewers, and its 100th year is a natural moment for Disney — whose characters and floats have been part of the tradition — to mark the occasion. Details of Disney's specific contributions are part of the broader centennial programming.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: How Disney is Celebrating 100 Years of The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade

item.title: Disney conservation hits 2 million sea turtle hatchlings at Vero Beach
item.description:
After more than 20 years of conservation work, the Disney Conservation team has estimated that over 2 million hatchlings have emerged from nests laid on the beaches along Disney's Vero Beach Resort, a Disney Vacation Club property. The milestone was made possible by the cast members who monitor and protect the nests season after season.

Two million hatchlings is a remarkable number for a single stretch of coastline, and it puts Disney's conservation work in perspective: the resort's beach program has quietly become one of the more significant sea turtle efforts in Florida. The story centers the cast members whose patient, nightly work made it happen.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Meet the Disney Cast Members Behind 2 Million Sea Turtle Hatchlings

item.title: Imagineers add new props to Remy's Ratatouille Adventure to hide screen seams
item.description:
Remy's Ratatouille Adventure at EPCOT has received new set-dressing in more show scenes to conceal screen seams, and Imagineering has shared a look at the changes along with some of the Easter eggs hidden in the attraction.

The ride has long drawn criticism for moments where the screen edges break the illusion, so the new props are a targeted fix: physical set pieces that keep guests inside the world rather than reminding them they're looking at a screen. It's a small, craft-level change, but it shows Imagineering still iterating on a ride years after it opened.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Imagineers Add More New Props to Remy's Ratatouille Adventure at EPCOT to Help Suspend Disbelief

item.title: Disney Parks mark Veterans Day with tributes across the resorts
item.description:
Disney Parks honored U.S. military veterans this Veterans Day with special moments of recognition for the courage, service, and sacrifice of those who served and those still in uniform. The company's admiration for military service goes back to its founders: Walt and Roy O. Disney both felt the pull of service, and Roy served in the U.S. Navy during World War I.

The tributes are part of a long-standing relationship between Disney and the military community that stretches from the company's earliest days to today, with the parks setting aside the day to recognize veterans and active-duty service members among their guests and cast members.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Disney Parks Honors Veterans with Special Veterans Day Tributes

item.title: Meet & greets coming from Hexed and Avengers: Doomsday at both U.S. parks
item.description:
Walt Disney World and Disneyland are adding new meet & greets featuring characters from the holiday season's two tentpole releases — the animated Hexed, arriving around Thanksgiving, and the live-action Avengers: Doomsday, hitting theaters around Christmas 2026. Guests will be able to meet characters from both films in the parks.

At least in Florida, the announcement is a pleasant surprise: Walt Disney World has frequently been criticized for being slow to bring new-film characters into the parks. This time the characters are arriving alongside the movies themselves, giving holiday visitors a chance to meet the new faces while the films are still fresh in theaters.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Meet & Greet Characters Coming to Disney World & Disneyland from New Holiday 2026 Tentpoles

item.title: Disney kicks off its 79th annual Toys for Tots drive
item.description:
Disney has launched its 79th annual toy drive benefiting the Marine Toys for Tots Foundation, part of its "Make the Holidays Magic" campaign. The drive aims to spread holiday cheer to kids and families who need it most, with Disney's relationship with Toys for Tots stretching back more than seven decades.

Nearly eight decades in, the partnership remains one of Disney's longest-running charitable traditions — a holiday fixture that turns the company's seasonal push into toys for children across the country.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Disney Launches Annual Toy Drive Benefitting Marine Toys for Tots

item.title: 2027 military discounts return, with the cheap year-long ticket and a first Lakeshore Lodge deal
item.description:
Walt Disney World has released its 2027 Armed Forces Salute ticket and resort discounts for military members — and the headliner is the return of the deeply discounted Disney Celebrates America year-long ticket, which costs less than half the price of an Annual Pass. The offer also includes the first-ever room-only deal at the new Lakeshore Lodge.

For military families planning a 2027 trip, the year-long ticket is the standout: a full year of park access at a fraction of annual-pass pricing, paired with resort discounts that now extend to Disney's newest lodge. It's one of the strongest military offers Disney has put out, and the Lakeshore Lodge deal is a first for the property.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Deep Discount Disney Celebrates America Year-Long Ticket Returns for 2027, First Deal on Lakeshore Lodge

item.title: Disney on Broadway returns to the 2027 EPCOT Festival of the Arts
item.description:
The Disney on Broadway Concert Series is coming back to the 2027 EPCOT International Festival of the Arts at Walt Disney World, with Broadway stars performing songs from Disney's stage shows. The announcement covers the full schedule of performers, dates and times, and whether the dining package is worth the money — plus a new CommuniCore experience debuting alongside the festival.

The concert series has become one of the festival's signature draws, pairing the visual-art focus of the event with live performances from the actors who brought Disney musicals to Broadway. The new CommuniCore offering adds another reason to plan a visit around the festival's run.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney on Broadway at 2027 EPCOT Festival of Arts: Concert Schedule & New CommuniCore Experience

item.title: Disney World resorts up to 50% off, rooms from $99
item.description:
Walt Disney World has rolled out what may be its deepest resort discount ever: up to 50% off rooms for late 2026 into early 2027, with rates starting at $99 a night for the general public. The offer covers a broad window of dates and is being described as an unprecedented, "scorching" sale by the standards of Disney's usual promotions.

The timing is notable — a half-off resort deal heading into the holiday season and beyond suggests Disney is working hard to fill rooms. For planners, it's the kind of offer that can reshape a trip budget: at $99 a night, a Disney resort stay starts to compete with off-property options. As with all Disney promotions, the best dates and resorts will go fast, and the usual blackout and availability caveats apply — but for anyone with flexible dates, this is the deal to check first.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Save 50% Off Resorts at Disney World in Late 2026 & 2027, Rooms Starting at $99!

item.title: First Disneyland ticket deals of 2027 announced
item.description:
Disneyland has announced its first ticket deal of 2027: discounted multi-day tickets for the general public, with 2-day and 3-day options going on sale soon. The offer gives West Coast planners an early chance to lock in savings on a 2027 visit.

Disney's ticket promotions tend to follow a familiar pattern — the headline discount is real, but the fine print matters: valid dates, blackout days, and which ticket types qualify. Still, a dedicated 2027 deal announced this early is a useful planning signal, and it pairs with the broader wave of Disney discounts rolling out for next year. Full dates and details are in the linked coverage, including comparisons with past promotions to judge whether this one is actually a good deal.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: New 3-4 Day Disneyland Ticket Deals Coming for 2027

item.title: Membership Magic Beyond returns for 2027 with better perks, no price hike
item.description:
Membership Magic Beyond — Disney Vacation Club's add-on membership — is coming back for 2027, and this time the news is genuinely good: the program is returning for a third year with improved perks and no price increase. That's a rare combination from Disney, where add-on programs usually get more expensive or thinner each year.

The membership bundles perks across Walt Disney World and Disneyland and has been praised by its fans as one of the best values in the DVC ecosystem. The full list of what's new and what's improved is in the linked article, but the headline is simple: same price, better benefits. For DVC members weighing whether to renew or join, the no-increase renewal makes the decision considerably easier.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: 2027 Membership Magic Beyond at Disney World & Disneyland: New & Improved Perks, No Price Increase

item.title: Fantastic Four arrive at Avengers Campus ahead of Avengers: Doomsday
item.description:
Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters December 18, and Disneyland is getting in on the action: the Fantastic Four are arriving at Avengers Campus, with heroic encounters, themed food, and merchandise celebrating the film's release. It's the latest example of Disney syncing its parks with its biggest movie openings.

The Campus takeover is the kind of limited-time overlay that rewards a visit around the film's debut — character meet-and-greets tied to a brand-new movie rarely stay static for long. Whether you're a Marvel completist or just visiting in December, the Doomsday celebration gives the land a fresh reason to visit. Details on the specific encounters and offerings are in the Disney Parks Blog post.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: Fantastic Four Arrive at Avengers Campus

item.title: Shanghai Disney's new Enchanted Star Hotel opens December 16
item.description:
Shanghai Disney Resort's third hotel has an opening date — and it's sooner than expected. The Shanghai Disney Enchanted Star Hotel opens December 16, 2026, a premium, family-friendly retreat on Wishing Star Lake, next to the Shanghai Disneyland Hotel.

The 400-room property packs dining, entertainment, and recreation under one roof, and its lakeside location puts it right in the heart of the resort. A new hotel opening weeks before the end of the year is a significant expansion for Shanghai Disney, which has grown steadily since opening in 2016. First-look details and photos are in the linked announcement.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: First Look: Shanghai Disney Resort Announces Details of New Hotel

item.title: EPCOT's Disney on Broadway concerts return for 10th anniversary season
item.description:
The Disney on Broadway Concert Series is back for its 10th anniversary at EPCOT's International Festival of the Arts, running January 15 through March 1, 2027. The festival — this year presented by Disney Lorcana — brings Broadway stars to the America Gardens Theatre to perform songs from Disney's stage productions.

Six different lineups are scheduled across the festival's run, so repeat visitors can catch different performers. The concert series has become one of the festival's anchor draws, and the 10th-anniversary edition is a milestone worth noting for anyone planning a winter EPCOT trip. The full schedule is in the linked post.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: EPCOT Festival of the Arts 2027 Disney on Broadway Concert Series Schedule

item.title: Disney's Imagineering app aims to break guests' phone habit
item.description:
Disney is developing a new app from Walt Disney Imagineering aimed at an unlikely target: the phones in guests' own hands. The head of Imagineering has said one goal is to use emerging technology to "break the spell" of visitors being glued to their screens — a frustration shared by many fans, given how much of a park visit now runs through apps, from Lightning Lane bookings to mobile food orders.

Details on what the app will actually do are still emerging, but the direction is clear: technology that pulls guests' attention back to the physical park rather than deeper into their screens. It's an interesting tension for Disney to navigate — the company built the screen-dependent park experience, and now its own Imagineers want to undo part of it. Whether the app succeeds will depend on execution, but the intent alone is a notable shift.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney Releasing New Imagineering App to Help ‘Break Spell’ of Guests Glued to Phones in Parks

item.title: Disney World announces Indiana Jones Epic Jr. Stunt Spectacular playground
item.description:
Walt Disney World is building a new kids' play area next to the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular at Hollywood Studios, called the Indiana Jones Epic Jr. Stunt Spectacular. The announcement finally answers what Imagineering has been doing with the construction site outside the long-running stunt show, which had been filed under the mysterious “Project Fedora” name.

It's the first of two Indiana Jones-adjacent play areas planned for the spot, so families with young kids get a new themed place to burn off energy right beside one of the park's classic shows. No opening date has been shared yet, but construction is already underway.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Announces Indiana Jones Epic Jr. Stunt Spectacular!

item.title: Disney joins the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade's 100th anniversary
item.description:
The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade turns 100 this year, and Disney is marking the milestone with its own celebration tied to the storied spectacle. For many Americans, the parade is the unofficial start of the holiday season, and the centennial makes this year's edition a bigger deal than usual.

Disney hasn't detailed every element of its participation yet, but expect the company's characters and entertainment to feature in the anniversary festivities. It's one of the holiday season's biggest set pieces, and the 100th running is the one to watch.

Sources

  • Disney Parks Blog: How Disney is Celebrating 100 Years of The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade

item.title: Target's Disney gift card flash sale is live through next Saturday
item.description:
The holiday shopping season is already underway, and Target has launched what Disney Tourist Blog calls the best Disney gift card deal of 2026. The flash sale started today and runs through next Saturday — well ahead of Black Friday, which is still more than two weeks out.

Disney gift cards are a practical way to prepay for a Walt Disney World trip, covering tickets, resorts, dining, and merchandise, so a discount effectively trims the cost of a whole vacation. The sale follows a couple of earlier doorbusters on Disney gift cards this season, but this Target offer is the strongest yet. If you're planning a Disney trip or buying gifts, this is the one to grab before it ends next Saturday.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Best Disney Gift Card Flash Sale of 2026 is Now Live!

item.title: Disney World refurbishment calendar updated for 2026–2027
item.description:
Disney Tourist Blog has updated its Walt Disney World refurbishment calendar covering ride closures for 2026 and 2027 across Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Hollywood Studios, and Animal Kingdom. Attractions close for routine maintenance, safety upgrades, improvements, and reimaginings — and the calendar tracks what's down and when.

Nobody wants their favorite ride closed during a trip, but knowing the schedule in advance lets you plan around it or shift dates. If you have a Disney World trip on the calendar for the coming year, it's worth checking the updated list before finalizing park days.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: 2026-2027 Disney World Refurbishment Calendar

item.title: You could win a stay in Cinderella Castle's secret suite in 2027
item.description:
Staying in the Cinderella Castle Suite — the famously unbookable room hidden inside Magic Kingdom's icon — is possible again in 2027 through a giveaway run by Give Kids the World. The prize is a full Walt Disney World vacation package built around a night in the suite, which money alone normally cannot buy.

It's a charity sweepstakes rather than a bookable room, so entry details and the retail value of the package matter if you're considering it — and supporting Give Kids the World is the point of the exercise. For most fans this is the only realistic path to sleeping inside the castle, so it's worth checking the giveaway terms before entering.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Win a Stay in Cinderella Castle's Secret Suite in 2027!

item.title: Disney World and Disneyland offer free holiday pins with gift card purchases
item.description:
Walt Disney World and Disneyland are giving away free limited-edition holiday pins with select gift card purchases this Christmas season, joining the usual round of seasonal gift card deals. It's a small perk, but the pins are exclusive to the promotion and likely to appeal to collectors.

The offer only applies to certain gift card purchases, so check which cards qualify and whether the pin is available at both resorts before buying. If you were already planning to buy Disney gift cards for the holidays, the free pin is a nice bonus; it's probably not worth buying a card just for the pin.

Sources

  • Disney Tourist Blog: Disney World Giving Free Gift with Christmas Gift Cards
